load_coco_caption_data: load COCO2014 caption dataset annotations and image paths into a data list for training
create_coco_caption_dataset: create a CocoCaptionDataset instance registered in the mmdet DATASETS registry for caption tasks
extract_image_id_from_annotation: extract the image ID from COCO annotation filenames by splitting on underscores
join_image_paths_with_backend: join image prefix paths with annotation filenames using mmengine file backend
register_coco_caption_module: register the CocoCaptionDataset class in the mmdet DATASETS registry for use in configs
